title: Prime Quadruplets and Jump Conditions on Arithmetic Functions
summary: We provide progress on the characterization of composite integers $n$ that satisfy the jump conditions $\varphi(n+12)=\varphi(n)+12$ and $σ(n+12)=σ(n)+12$ simultaneously. While it is known that prime quadruplets $(p,p+2,p+6,p+8)$ generate solutions $n=p(p+8)$, the complete characterization remains an open conjecture. We prove that this characterization is complete when $n$ and $n+12$ are both squarefree semiprimes, and that no solution $n$ can be a prime power. Furthermore, a complete search up to $10^{12}$ resulted in no counterexamples to the conjecture. If this conjecture is proven true,…
